description: Calculate a deterministic OpenFate Bazi/Four Pillars chart with True Solar Time correction, Day Master, DAYUN_SECOND_V2 onset receipts, Da Yun cycles, and branch interactions. Pass an exact birth time plus timezone or timezoneId for a calculated V2 onset; otherwise inspect the explicit unavailable/fallback receipt.

dayBoundaryMode.description: Day-change rule. ZI_HOUR_23 means 23:00 starts the next day pillar.

dstOffset.description: Daylight saving offset in hours to remove from civil clock time. Use 1 for one-hour DST.

enableTrueSolarTime.description: Apply true solar time when longitude and timezone data are available.

gender.description: Birth gender used for Da Yun direction.

hour.description: Birth hour in local civil time, 0-23. Omit when birth time is unknown.

isLeapMonth.description: Whether the lunar input month is a leap month. Used only when calendarType is lunar.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in decimal degrees. Enables true solar time correction.

minute.description: Birth minute in local civil time.

second.description: Birth second in local civil time.

timezone.description: UTC offset in hours for the birth clock time, such as 8 for China or -5 for US Eastern Standard Time.

timezoneId.description: Optional IANA timezone ID, such as Asia/Shanghai or America/New_York.

year.description: Birth year. Use the lunar year when calendarType is lunar.

name: calculate_bazi_chart
title: Calculate Bazi Chart
